method.renderer: Real Google Chrome headless Canvas 2D / Path2D
method.threshold: R < 133 && B - R > 12 (both decoded reference PNG and rendered vector)
method.independence: No contour-generation code imported; Chromium independently rasterizes SVG path strings.
method.scope: Binary foreground silhouette only. Does not assert RGB, antialiasing, original-video extraction accuracy, semantic sport identity, or device performance.
